text:
maria: async check-in — quick notes for audits / KMS / IAM
What I did: ran weekly audit sweep, opened ticket RW-4823 for expired service-account keys; did a dry-run KMS rotation in staging (no downtime). :white_check_mark:
Blockers: vuln scan flagged openssl 1.1.1 in a handful of images, need infra to rebuild those images (risk: dedicated customers on old builds).
Today: will open PR for the rotation playbook, ping infra for image rebuilds, and draft checklist for the rotation run. pinging @alex for PR review.

alex: saw RW-4823, will take the PR review after standup. can we target Sat 02:00 UTC for the actual rotation window? :calendar:

sam: quick note — the SRE runbook needs a vault -> KMS mapping section. started a draft in the internal doc, will add examples. link: https://redwood.internal/docs/vault-kms-mapping (internal). :memo:

jin: snag in staging: rotation failed on one node due to iam:PassRole missing on the service account. opened RW-4827 for perms fix. applied a temp workaround so other nodes could proceed.

deploy-bot: PR #4897 (kms-rotation-playbook) CI: unit tests passed, integration test failed on staging-only cluster (timeout). See CI logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/4897. :gear:

maria: thanks. @sam can you add the mapping table and the verification steps to the playbook? @jin add the iam:PassRole diff to RW-4827 and mark high-priority.

alex: will review #4897 tonight. if Sat 02:00 UTC works, i'll block the maintenance window and notify support + post in #general. cc @security-comms for customer-facing note. :loudspeaker:

sam: added mapping table + verification snippet to the playbook. snippet for dry-run CLI:
```bash
redwood kms rotate --key-id projects/prod/key1 --dry-run
# verify: redwood kms status --key-id projects/prod/key1
```
Also added a short rollback procedure.

jin: after IAM fix applied in RW-4827, re-ran the rotation in staging — green across all nodes. will add the alias/docs tweak so alerts don't trigger post-rotation.

maria: plan summary: merge PR -> canary on 2 nodes -> monitor token ops 30m -> full roll. i'll create checklist issue RW-4830 with steps + monitoring queries.

alex: pinged @security-comms for the customer notice draft. also: can someone confirm whether any Dedicated customers are on the affected image build? need list before we announce. :eyes:

sam: spoke with solutions-eng — two Dedicated customers on older image build. i'll open support tickets and include mitigation steps.

jin: blockers cleared from my side, monitoring looks stable.

maria: thanks all. reminder: quarterly compliance audit next Tue — please upload audit artifacts to Confluence under /security/audit/quarterly. i'll follow up with a checklist in RW-4831. :clipboard:

alex: thumbs-up, will review the PR tonight. :thumbsup:

sam: added final comments to the playbook PR.

maria: closing this async thread — will post updates to RW-4830 and ping when the maintenance window is set. :wave:
